headline: Iberostar Advances €1 Billion Caribbean Growth With Jamaica Luxury Hotel
summary: Spanish hotel group Iberostar is advancing a €1 billion resort upgrade strategy through 2028, reopening its JOIA Rose Hall luxury property in Montego Bay, Jamaica.
why: Iberostar Hotels & Resorts is a major multinational Spanish hospitality group operating luxury resorts globally.

impacts.name: Iberostar Hotels & Resorts
impacts.why: Reopening luxury properties supports Iberostar's €1 billion global resort expansion plan.
